🏠 Between January and March, 135,580 households in England were in temporary accommodation, the highest ever recorded. 177,530 children are among them.

Councils have spent over 10 billion pounds on it in five years and own not one extra home for it. You cannot fix a shortage while adding demand faster than you build.
